segments.text: Good morning. I am calling about the Saturday photography workshop.
The morning group is full, but two places remain in the session at half past two.
That session has moved from Room Four to the garden studio beside reception.
Please arrive ten minutes early and bring a reusable water bottle.
I will reserve one place and send the updated details by email.

lexicalTargets.meaning: secure a position before the event
